newsitem.title: GERMANY: MTU sees 1996 sales up 13 pct.
newsitem.headline: MTU sees 1996 sales up 13 pct.

text.p: Daimler-Benz AG unit MTU Motoren- und Turbinen-Union Friedrichshafen GmbH expects sales to rise 13 percent in 1996 to 1.5 billion marks, finance chief Werner Speckner said.
That would be the steepest rise MTU has seen in many years, Speckner told a company gathering. Sales should rise again in 1997, but more slowly, he said.
The diesel engine sector, which includes subsidiaries L'Orange, MTU Asia and MTU Australia, will see 1996 sales rise 10 percent to about 1.6 billion marks.
High capacity utilisation meant the Friedrichshafen workforce declined by only 60 to 4,940. In 1997, a greater number of jobs may be created, Speckner said.
